# Rack fan and probe cabling

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `rack-fan-harness` |
| Category | fabricated |

Off-the-shelf parts only, nothing crimped. Each fan reaches 500 mm with its own
200 mm lead and the included Noctua 30 cm extension. Runs longer than that get
standard 4-pin fan extensions, one or two chained per fan (no splitters: every fan
keeps its own tach line to the controller). The exhaust bank, beside the controller,
likely needs none; the floor bank, about the cabinet height away, likely needs
0.6-1 m more per fan. The probes connect to the controller's 1-Wire screw terminal
on their own leads. One Cat 5e or better patch lead runs from the ESP32-POE to a
non-PoE port on the rack switch. Lengths are set
once the cabinet and the controller position are known. Route along the cabinet
frame with ties, clear of every rotor, with slack for opening the door if the
intake fans sit on it.
